verdict.rationale: Reclaim's first-party Calendar Sync feature creates synced copies of source events on a destination calendar. Those copies stay up to date automatically as the source changes, so availability holds across calendars, and #nosync gives per-event exclusion (docs-13, 18, 23, 62). Paying users independently corroborate relying on it for cross-calendar sync between Google and O365 (comm-3, comm-2). Missing for 10: explicit documentation that synced copies appear as privacy-masked 'busy' blocks in both directions between work and personal calendars, and clear support for non-Google/Outlook personal calendars beyond the iCloud shared-calendar route.
